machine.type: RCA/etch wet bench per the node equipment list: SC1 bath 10 L at 80 C and SC2 bath 10 L at 80 C with immersion heater envelopes (2.479 kWh/d each), DHF etch bath at ambient, and the DIW rinse bay, on a bench deck over a 20 mm plinth inside a four-post hold-down frame that pins the registry box (X-PAR-04)
